extracted.name: Chili Cheese Dip
extracted.description: This easy Chili Cheese Dip is made in just 10 minutes with only 4 ingredients (chili, cheese, cream cheese, and salsa)! Make it on the stovetop or slow cooker.
ingredient_lines: 2 1/2 cups chili (homemade, or 2 (14 oz cans) store-bought (625g))
4 ounces cream cheese (, cut into cubes (113g))
2 cups shredded cheese (, I use pepperjack and sharp cheddar (226g))
cayenne pepper or hot sauce (, optional, for heat)
instruction_lines: Place all ingredients in a medium saucepan over medium-low heat. Cook, stirring constantly, until all ingredients are thoroughly combined and the cheese is bubbly and melted, about 5 minutes.
Serve with tortilla chips, bread cubes or vegetables. Serve with a chili hot dog, over nachos, or baked potatoes.

Spray the bottom of your slow cooker with non-stick cooking spray (or use a liner). Place cream cheese cubes in the slow cooker. Smoother them with chili, then salsa, then the cheddar cheese. Cook on LOW for 1-3 hours. Stir and serve.
categories: Chili cheese dip with cream cheese
